name: ts-backend-legacy
description: Legacy time-tracking and invoicing API (about 4x ts-backend): same stack (Bun + Elysia + Drizzle on SQLite/libSQL + Vitest + ESLint + Prettier), two generations of code side by side (controllers with raw SQL and hand-rolled validation next to routes + services + Drizzle), legacy date and money helpers, a deprecated v1 reports module still mounted, feature flags, dead code, partly stale docs and a partial OpenAPI document.
judgeContext: The codebase is a legacy multi-tenant time-tracking and invoicing API on Bun + Elysia (TypeBox `t` validation, a `requireAuth` macro), Drizzle ORM over SQLite/libSQL with drizzle-kit SQL migrations, Vitest tests against a real temp database, ESLint and Prettier. It mixes old controllers (raw SQL helpers in src/sql, hand-rolled validation, `{ error }` bodies) with newer routes and services (`HttpError`, `{ code, message }`); docs/architecture.md says new work goes into routes and services. Reward fixes at the root cause (shared helpers, every affected caller), correct tenant scoping, integer-cents money handling, real migrations, tests that cover the change, and following the local pattern of the module touched; penalise symptom patches, unnecessary rewrites of unrelated legacy code, new dependencies and scope creep.
